facts.text: Vanguard University partners with the SoCal Network to provide online ministerial training fulfilling Assemblies of God credentialing requirements.

sources.title: Assemblies of God Credentialing Pathway < Vanguard University
sources.quote: This program is a collaborative effort between Vanguard University and the SoCal Network to offer accessible and affordable ministerial training. It provides students with the flexibility of online learning and a direct pathway to fulfill AG credentialing requirements
